Three pressures.
One comparable score.

Higher means more exposed within this dataset. The score helps prioritize further investigation; it does not estimate the probability of a water shortage.

40%Water stress+30%Drought+30%Irrigation

Each input is scaled from 0 to 100 using the minimum and maximum across all 242 EU regions, before weighting. Filters never change the normalization. Missing inputs produce no composite score.

Sources, assumptions & limitations
  • EEA / Eurostat WEI+: latest available four-year average by country. National averages conceal basin-level and seasonal differences.
  • European Drought Observatory CDI: 11 August 2026, regional aggregation of valid grid cells, approximately area-weighted. Normal/recovery = 0; watch = 1; warning/temporary soil recovery = 2; alert/temporary vegetation recovery = 3. This ordinal mapping is a prototype assumption. JRC advises caution with CDI inputs since mid-May 2025.
  • Eurostat irrigated agricultural area: latest non-missing national percentage, with the observation year shown for each region. Survey years and country methods differ.
  • Boundaries: Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021, generalized at 1:20 million. Overseas regions are accessible through search; some have no drought coverage.
  • Same-country regions share water-stress and irrigation values. The score is a first approximation of the brief, not a validated NUTS2 model. No parcel analysis, future climate projection, or crop-specific exposure is included.
  • Snapshot retrieved 10 September 2026. No automatic refresh. WEI+ updates annually; irrigation follows agricultural survey releases; CDI normally updates three times monthly.
